current: 15.3  	Data Security.  Each Party shall maintain a written information security program that includes administrative, technical, and physical safeguards appropriate to the nature and sensitivity of the data processed under this Agreement. In the event of any actual or reasonably suspected unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification, or destruction of research data (a "Security Incident"), the affected Party shall notify the other Party within forty-eight (48) hours of discovering such incident and shall cooperate in investigating and remedying the Security Incident.
final: 15.3  	Data Security.  Each Party shall maintain a written information security program that includes administrative, technical, and physical safeguards appropriate to the nature and sensitivity of the data processed under this Agreement. In the event of any actual or reasonably suspected unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification, or destruction of research data (a "Security Incident"), the affected Party shall (a) provide the other Party with preliminary written notice within seventy-two (72) hours after discovery, identifying the nature of the incident as then understood, the data and systems believed to be affected, a point of contact, and an estimated timeline for investigation, in sufficient detail for the other Party to assess its own regulatory exposure; and (b) provide full written disclosure within seven (7) days after forensic confirmation of the incident’s scope, and shall cooperate in investigating and remedying the Security Incident. Where an incident originates on closed-network hardware or infrastructure that requires physical investigation before its scope can be assessed, the preliminary notice shall so state and shall include the point of contact and estimated timeline, and the seventy-two (72) hour window shall apply to that preliminary notice rather than to the assessment itself. Each Party shall maintain access logs for any monitoring platform, sensor network, or other system of that Party that connects to or collects data from the other Party’s systems, and shall disclose to the other Party in writing, within thirty (30) days after the Effective Date and thereafter within ten (10) business days after discovery, any access event involving the other Party’s systems or data that occurred before the Effective Date or was not logged at the time it occurred. The notification timelines in this Section are intended to support each Party’s obligations under HIPAA and other applicable data protection laws, and nothing herein shall shorten any period required by such laws.
